an4.268:1.1: …pe… attanā ca pisuṇavāco hoti parañca pisuṇāya vācāya samādapeti pisuṇāya vācāya ca samanuñño hoti pisuṇāya vācāya ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati. imehi kho …pe…
an4.268:2.1: attanā ca pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti parañca pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇiyā samādapeti pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇiyā ca samanuñño hoti pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati. imehi
